essence: The art-path is to be expounded in accordance with glorious Shambhava knowledge.
The separate principle is named after each group's following in the world-middle.
The principle whose nature is approach to its own class while separated from the other class is called kala.
The subtle power within the principles is designated kalā, by analogy with the bearer in earth.
The thing's non-division across alternatives follows from rejecting a following universal.
